card.fact_statement: The IRGC accused the United States of providing support in the killing of Ismail Haniyeh.
card.source_span: On 3 August, the IRGC said that Haniyeh was killed with "a short-range projectile carrying about 7 kilograms (15 lb) of explosive materials" that was launched from outside the building he was staying in and accused Israel of responsibility in the killing and the United States of providing support.

card.fact_statement: Masoud Pezeshkian strengthened diplomatic ties with Saudi Arabia.
card.source_span: Following Pezeshkian's victory in the 2024 presidential election, Saudi Arabia's King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) sent congratulatory messages.
